title: What Would You Do If You Were a Superhero?
description: Imagine you suddenly gained superpowers! Answer 12 scenarios to discover what kind of superhero you'd become and how you'd use your powers.

questions.text: You wake up with the ability to fly. What's your first move?

options.text: Fly to the highest point to see the world from above
Stay home and practice controlling your power first
Immediately fly out to help people in need
Test your limits and push yourself to fly higher and faster

questions.text: You discover a villain planning to rob a bank. What do you do?

options.text: Single-handedly stop the robbery and capture the villain
Call the authorities and wait for backup
Try to talk the villain down and understand their motives
Create a plan with other heroes and act as a team

questions.text: Your secret identity is at risk of being exposed. How do you handle it?

options.text: Come out publicly and embrace being a hero
Create a convincing cover story and keep both lives separate
Disappear and start fresh in a new city
Ask your loved ones for help and support

questions.text: A new hero team asks you to join. What's your response?

options.text: Join immediately - strength in numbers!
Decline - I work better alone
Ask many questions about their mission and values first
Join as a reserve member to test the waters

questions.text: You have the chance to save one person or many. What's your choice?

options.text: Save as many people as possible
Save the one person who matters most to me
Try to find a way to save everyone
Let others decide - I won't play god

questions.text: Your arch-enemy offers you a truce. How do you react?

options.text: Accept - peace is always better than war
Refuse - some enemies can't be trusted
Pretend to accept but prepare for betrayal
Use the truce to understand their past and find common ground

questions.text: What would be your hero name?

options.text: Something intimidating and powerful
Something mysterious and cryptic
Something inspiring and hopeful
I'd keep my identity secret and use a simple code name

questions.text: You discover your powers come from a dangerous source. What do you do?

options.text: Keep using them - the ends justify the means
Find a way to purify or neutralize the danger
Stop using them entirely and find another way
Share this knowledge with other heroes to find a solution together

questions.text: A government agency wants to control how you use your powers. Your response?

options.text: Cooperate - rules keep everyone safe
Refuse - I'll protect people my way
Negotiate for autonomy while staying within reason
Go underground and operate in secret

questions.text: What's your approach to training new heroes?

options.text: Hands-on, throw them into action to learn
Structured curriculum with strict discipline
Lead by example and teach through experience
Let them figure it out on their own - struggle builds character

questions.text: Your powers start to fade. How do you handle it?

options.text: Find any way to restore them, no matter the cost
Accept it and focus on mentoring the next generation
Adapt and become a strategist instead
Retire peacefully and enjoy a normal life

questions.text: What's your ultimate goal as a hero?

options.text: Create a world where no one needs heroes
Protect the innocent at any cost
Inspire humanity to be better
Become the ultimate symbol of justice

INTJ.title: The Strategic Mastermind
INTJ.description: Like Batman or Iron Man, you're the ultimate tactician. You analyze every situation, plan multiple steps ahead, and rely on your intellect over brute force. Your powers are a tool to execute your grand designs.

INTP.title: The Scientific Innovator
INTP.description: You approach heroism like a scientist - constantly experimenting, improving, and finding clever solutions. Your powers are just another variable to optimize.

ENTJ.title: The Natural Leader
ENTJ.description: You're born to lead, making tough decisions and taking charge in crisis situations. Others naturally look to you for direction.

ENTP.title: The Creative Problem-Solver
ENTP.description: You fight with wit and innovation, always finding unconventional solutions. You make chaos work in your favor.

INFJ.title: The Guardian Angel
INFJ.description: You're guided by a strong moral compass and a deep desire to protect. You see the potential for good in everyone.

INFP.title: The Idealistic Dreamer
INFP.description: You fight for what you believe in, no matter the odds. Your strength comes from your convictions and empathy.

ENFJ.title: The Inspiring Mentor
ENFJ.description: You lift others up and bring out the best in your team. You're as much a leader of hearts as of actions.

ENFP.title: The Energetic Champion
ENFP.description: Your boundless energy and optimism are contagious. You inspire others to believe in themselves.

ISTJ.title: The Reliable Sentinel
ISTJ.description: You take your responsibilities seriously and never waver from your duty. Others know they can count on you.

ISFJ.title: The Devoted Protector
ISFJ.description: You quietly guard those you love, often putting others' safety before your own. Your strength is in your dedication.

ESTJ.title: The Commander
ESTJ.description: You take charge and get things done efficiently. You believe in order, structure, and decisive action.

ESFJ.title: The Community Builder
ESFJ.description: You focus on protecting communities and building connections. You're the hero who remembers everyone's name.

ISTP.title: The Cool Operator
ISTP.description: You stay calm under pressure and adapt instantly to any situation. You're the one who acts when others freeze.

ISFP.title: The Artistic Defender
ISFP.description: You fight with style and grace, following your own moral code. Your actions speak louder than words.

ESTP.title: The Daring Adventurer
ESTP.description: You live for the thrill and aren't afraid to take risks. You dive into action without overthinking.

ESFP.title: The Heroic Showman
ESFP.description: You bring energy and drama to heroism. You make saving the day look cool and inspiring.
